title: Emergent Generalization by Representation Learning in Artificial Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2607.10430v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dimensionality reduction has proven powerful for identifying neural manifolds, which are low-dimensional structures underlying high-dimensional neural activity. These low-dimensional representations have improved the interpretability of population-level coding. Yet whether such low-dimensional representations are biologically relevant and confer functional advantages in learning systems, or merely reflect neuron-level activity, remains contested in neuroscience. We show that an explicit information bottleneck forcing a recurrent neural network to learn a low-dimensional representation is necessary for rotational and out-of-distribution generalisation in a time-series prediction task. translated_title: 人工神经网络中通过表征学习实现涌现泛化
translated_abstract: 降维已被证明是识别神经流形的有力工具，神经流形是高维神经活动背后的低维结构。这些低维表征提高了群体级编码的可解释性。然而，这种低维表征是否具有生物学意义并能为学习系统带来功能优势，还是仅仅反映神经元层面的活动，在神经科学领域仍存在争议。我们证明，在时间序列预测任务中，显式的信息瓶颈迫使循环神经网络学习低维表征，这对实现旋转泛化和分布外泛化是必要的。利用因果涌现的信息论度量，我们刻画了这种表征在从记忆到泛化转变过程中的动力学特征，发现了一条非单调的轨迹：表征维度先下降、达到最小值，随后……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明在循环神经网络中施加显式信息瓶颈以学习低维表征，是时间序列预测任务中实现旋转泛化与分布外泛化的必要条件，并通过因果涌现的信息论度量揭示了表征在记忆到泛化转变过程中的非单调动力学轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that an explicit information bottleneck forcing recurrent neural networks to learn low-dimensional representations is necessary for rotational and out-of-distribution generalization in time-series prediction tasks, and characterizes the non-monotonic dynamics of such representations across the memorization-to-generalization transition using information-theoretic measures of causal emergence.
